Content-sized document without an at-page rule

This document declares no page size, so the exporter must measure the content bounding box in print media and emit exactly one page of that size with nothing cropped anywhere along the way.

Tinted bands, borders and inline SVG below must all appear in the output byte for byte on every run.

The closing paragraph anchors the tail-of-document sample so any truncation of the final region is caught by the content check.
